summary: @flexmr/utils resolves its sole dependency from an off-registry HTTPS URL
details: package.json declares the only dependency, `daemon-thread-lookup-buffer`, as a direct HTTPS URL to `https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/daemon-thread-lookup-buffer` instead of a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever tarball that host returns and executes any lifecycle scripts inside, with no version pin and no integrity check — the controller of artifacts.creditslib.com controls code that runs on the installer's machine at install time, and on every consumer that `require`s the package (the shipped `index.js` is a one-line stub that re-exports that dependency). The @flexmr-scoped package name combined with an unrelated-host transitive source matches the dependency-confusion shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
